title: SentinelOps Event Envelope
description: The envelope every SentinelOps service uses to publish and consume events over Redpanda's Kafka-compatible API. See docs/events/event-envelope.md.

eventId.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance; the idempotency key.

eventType.description: The dot-versioned event type, matching the Kafka topic name.

schemaVersion.description: The payload schema version, incremented only on breaking payload changes.

occurredAt.description: UTC instant the underlying fact occurred, not when it was published.

correlationId.description: Propagated across the request/event chain that produced this event.

producer.description: Logical name of the service that produced this event.

payload.description: Event-type-specific body; validated separately against its own schema.
